```csharp
(OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileFlow signIn) => {

    /*** creating IMobileScreen 'SignIn' ***/
    var signIn2 = signIn.CreateScreen("SignIn");
    signIn2.GetESpace().Roles.ToList().ForEach(x => x.Delete());
    var eSpace = signIn.GetESpace();
    var mOD_DEMO_Roles = eSpace.References.Named("MOD_DEMO_Roles");
    var mOD_DEMO_PortalUser = mOD_DEMO_Roles.Roles.Named("MOD_DEMO_PortalUser");
    signIn2.Roles.Add(mOD_DEMO_PortalUser);
    var anonymous = eSpace.SystemRoles.OfType<OutSystems.Model.Logic.ISystemRole>().Named("Anonymous");
    signIn2.Roles.Add(anonymous);
    signIn2.AnonymousAccess = false; // default value
    signIn2.CustomURL = true;
    signIn2.Description = null; // default value
    signIn2.HorizontalPosition = 2371;
    signIn2.PageName = "signin";
    signIn2.Public = true;
    signIn2.SetTitle("\"Sign in\"");
    signIn2.VerticalPosition = 1457;

    var errorMessage = signIn2.CreateLocalVariable("ErrorMessage");
    errorMessage.DataType = eSpace.TextType;
    errorMessage.SetDefaultValue(null); // default value

    var showError = signIn2.CreateLocalVariable("ShowError");
    showError.DataType = eSpace.BooleanType;
    showError.SetDefaultValue(null); // default value
    signIn2.OnDestroy.Destination = null; // default value
    signIn2.OnInitialize.Destination = null; // default value
    signIn2.OnRender.Destination = null; // default value

    var showErrorEvent = signIn2.CreateScreenAction("ShowErrorEvent");
    showErrorEvent.Description = null; // default value

    var errorMsg = showErrorEvent.CreateInputParameter("ErrorMsg");
    errorMsg.DataType = eSpace.TextType;
    errorMsg.IsMandatory = true; // default value

    var onReady = signIn2.CreateScreenAction("OnReady");
    onReady.Description = null; // default value

    var startNode = onReady.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IStartNode>();
    startNode.IsDisabled = false; // default value

    var commentNode = onReady.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.ICommentNode>();
    commentNode.HorizontalPosition = 4300;
    commentNode.Text = "Runs once the screen has rendered.";
    commentNode.VerticalPosition = 1000; // default value

    var onSignInReady = onReady.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IExecuteServerActionNode>("OnSignInReady");
    var onSignInReady2 = eSpace.ServerActions.Named("OnSignInReady");
    onSignInReady.Action = onSignInReady2;
    onSignInReady.AnimationEffect = OutSystems.Model.Enumerations.ExecuteActionAnimationEffectType.None; // default value
    onSignInReady.HorizontalPosition = 3200;
    onSignInReady.VerticalPosition = 3200;

    var setDateFormat = onReady.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IExecuteClientActionNode>("SetDateFormat").ConnectedBelow(onSignInReady, 1829);
    var mOD_DEMO_Configurations_Lib = eSpace.References.Named("MOD_DEMO_Configurations_Lib");
    var setDateFormat2 = mOD_DEMO_Configurations_Lib.ClientActions.Named("SetDateFormat");
    setDateFormat.Action = setDateFormat2;
    var dateFormat = setDateFormat2.InputParameters.Named("DateFormat");
    setDateFormat.SetArgumentValue(dateFormat, "\"yyyy-MM-dd\"");

    var endNode = onReady.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IEndNode>();
    endNode.HorizontalPosition = 3196;
    endNode.VerticalPosition = 6840;
    signIn2.OnReady.Destination = onReady;
    startNode.Target = onSignInReady;
    setDateFormat.Target = endNode;

    var startNode2 = showErrorEvent.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IStartNode>();

    var assignNode = showErrorEvent.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IAssignNode>();
    assignNode.Label = null; // default value

    var assignment = assignNode.CreateAssignment("ShowError", "True");
    startNode2.Target = assignNode;

    var assignNode2 = showErrorEvent.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IAssignNode>();

    var assignment2 = assignNode2.CreateAssignment("ErrorMessage", "ErrorMsg");
    assignNode.Target = assignNode2;

    var endNode2 = showErrorEvent.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IEndNode>();
    assignNode2.Target = endNode2;

    var navigateToDashboard = signIn2.CreateScreenAction("NavigateToDashboard");
    navigateToDashboard.Description = null; // default value

    var startNode3 = navigateToDashboard.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IStartNode>();

    var destinationNode = navigateToDashboard.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IDestinationNode>();
    var mainFlow = eSpace.MobileFlows.Named("MainFlow");
    var dashboard = mainFlow.Nodes.OfType<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileScreen>().Named("Dashboard");
    destinationNode.Destination = dashboard;
    destinationNode.Transition = OutSystems.Model.Enumerations.TransitionTypeWithInheritance.Inherited; // default value
    startNode3.Target = destinationNode;

    var navigateToHome = signIn2.CreateScreenAction("NavigateToHome");

    var startNode4 = navigateToHome.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IStartNode>();

    var destinationNode2 = navigateToHome.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IDestinationNode>();
    var home = mainFlow.Nodes.OfType<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileScreen>().Named("Home");
    destinationNode2.Destination = home;
    startNode4.Target = destinationNode2;

    var toggleError = signIn2.CreateScreenAction("ToggleError");

    var startNode5 = toggleError.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IStartNode>();

    var assignNode3 = toggleError.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IAssignNode>();

    var assignment3 = assignNode3.CreateAssignment("ShowError", "False");
    startNode5.Target = assignNode3;

    var endNode3 = toggleError.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IEndNode>();
    assignNode3.Target = endNode3;

    var layoutSignInInstance = signIn2.CreateWidget<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.Widgets.IMobileBlockInstanceWidget>();
    layoutSignInInstance.CustomStyle = null; // default value
    var mOD_DEMO_Layouts = eSpace.References.Named("MOD_DEMO_Layouts");
    var demoLayouts = mOD_DEMO_Layouts.MobileFlows.Named("DemoLayouts");
    var layoutSignIn = demoLayouts.Nodes.OfType<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileBlockSignature>().Named("LayoutSignIn");
    layoutSignInInstance.SourceBlock = layoutSignIn;
    var extendedClass = layoutSignIn.InputParameters.Named("ExtendedClass");
    layoutSignInInstance.SetArgumentValue(extendedClass, null);

    var placeholderContentWidget = layoutSignInInstance.PlaceholdersContent.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Placeholder?.Name == "MainContent");
    var showErrorIf = placeholderContentWidget.CreateWidget<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.Widgets.IIfWidget>("ShowErrorIf");
    showErrorIf.Animate = false; // default value
    showErrorIf.SetCondition("ShowError");

    var container = showErrorIf.TrueBranch.CreateWidget<ServiceStudio.Plugin.NRWidgets.IContainer>();
    container.SetStyle("\"alert alert-error\"");
    container.SetVisible("ErrorMessage <> \"\"");

    var event1 = container.CreateEvent();
    event1.Event = "onclick";
    event1.Handler = toggleError;

    var otpPanelInstance = placeholderContentWidget.CreateWidget<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.Widgets.IMobileBlockInstanceWidget>();
    otpPanelInstance.CustomStyle = null; // default value
    var mOD_DEMO_Portal_CW = eSpace.References.Named("MOD_DEMO_Portal_CW");
    var mainFlow2 = mOD_DEMO_Portal_CW.MobileFlows.Named("MainFlow");
    var otpPanel = mainFlow2.Nodes.OfType<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileBlockSignature>().Named("OtpPanel");
    otpPanelInstance.SourceBlock = otpPanel;
    var eventHandler = otpPanelInstance.EventHandlers.FirstOrDefault(e => e.Event.Name == "ShowErrorEvent");
    eventHandler.Handler = showErrorEvent;
    eventHandler.SetArgumentValue(errorMsg, "ErrorMsg");
    var eventHandler2 = otpPanelInstance.EventHandlers.FirstOrDefault(e => e.Event.Name == "NavigateToDashboard");
    eventHandler2.Handler = navigateToDashboard;
    var eventHandler3 = otpPanelInstance.EventHandlers.FirstOrDefault(e => e.Event.Name == "NavigateToHome");
    eventHandler3.Handler = navigateToHome;
    var eventHandler4 = otpPanelInstance.EventHandlers.FirstOrDefault(e => e.Event.Name == "ScrollToEvent");
    eventHandler4.Handler = null; // default value
}
```
